item.title: Fly-tipped DIY/building waste in residents' car park requiring removal, 20th August
item.description:
A substantial quantity of DIY/building and mixed waste was fly-tipped in the residents' car park at 67F Crystal Palace Park Road on 10 July 2026 and remains there. The incident has already been reported to Bromley Enviro-crime (report 652151) and is under investigation. The investigating officer asked me to report the waste through FixMyStreet to arrange cleansing/removal. This is fly-tipped waste, not residents' waste, and includes DIY/building materials which I cannot take to the recycling centre myself. Please arrange clearance of the dumped waste.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Crystal Palace Park Road, Crystal Palace, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
